title: Preparing for a prenatal yoga class

see_how.label: NHS prenatal yoga class and safety information

scenes.caption: Check suitability with your healthcare professional
scenes.narration_line: Before trying prenatal yoga, ask your healthcare professional whether it is suitable for you.

scenes.caption: Choose a qualified, pregnancy-aware teacher
scenes.narration_line: Choose an appropriately qualified teacher and tell them you are pregnant.

scenes.caption: Gather support for the linked NHS class
scenes.narration_line: For the linked NHS class, prepare three cushions, a mat, and a blanket or large towel.

scenes.caption: Keep water nearby; stay within your limits
scenes.narration_line: Drink water and keep the activity gentle enough to continue a conversation.
safety_points: Choose a class designed for pregnancy.

scenes.caption: Stop if pain or illness develops
scenes.narration_line: Stop immediately if you feel pain or become unwell; seek medical advice if symptoms persist or concern you.
